findings.evidence: The grader live pass reports PTL-LIV-004: nthh.github.io does not expose Content-Type, Content-Length, Content-Range, Accept-Ranges and ETag for browser clients; its representative asset is the collection style JSON.
findings.fix: Serve catalog assets from a host with the required exposed response headers and verify the live pass again.

findings.evidence: The grader live pass reports PTL-LIV-005: nthh.github.io answers the conditional range CORS preflight with HTTP 405 and lacks the required allowed methods and request headers.
findings.fix: Use a host that accepts the specified GET/HEAD and conditional Range preflight requests for catalog assets.

findings.evidence: The captured table:columns has no descriptions for 618 LakeATLAS entries; GRWL also has 16 undescribed entries at /nodes/2/table_columns, despite separately available producer dictionaries.
findings.fix: Generate table:columns descriptions from the existing pinned field dictionaries and producer semantics.
